direct.label: Take the left ravine! Go!
direct.narrator_line: Ranger! Left ravine — the right is blocked by fire!

direct.label: The right pass! Climb NOW!
direct.narrator_line: Right pass! The dragon circled north — move!

direct.label: Straight up the ridge!
direct.narrator_line: Ranger! Straight up the ridge — no time for switchbacks!

direct.label: Down the scree — SLIDE!
direct.narrator_line: Down the scree slope! Controlled slide — GO!

direct.label: Full rope — extend the line!
direct.narrator_line: Ranger! Full rope out — bridge that chasm!

direct.label: Half rope — hold the slack!
direct.narrator_line: Half rope! Hold it taut — don't let them fall!

direct.label: Reel in the rope!
direct.narrator_line: Reel it in! Pull them up — fast!

direct.label: Left flank — ADVANCE!
direct.narrator_line: Left flank advance! Push forward!

direct.label: Left flank — HOLD!
direct.narrator_line: Left flank hold position!

direct.label: Right flank — ADVANCE!
direct.narrator_line: Right flank — push up the slope!

direct.label: Right flank — FALL BACK!
direct.narrator_line: Right flank fall back! Dragon incoming!

direct.label: Fire the signal arrow!
direct.narrator_line: Signal arrow! Light it and fire — mark our position!

direct.label: Forge to maximum heat!
direct.narrator_line: Artificer! Forge to maximum — we need dragonbane steel!

direct.label: Forge to half heat!
direct.narrator_line: Ease the forge to half — it's cracking the stone!

direct.label: Bank the forge — low heat!
direct.narrator_line: Bank the forge! Low heat — save the bellows!

direct.label: Quench the forge!
direct.narrator_line: Quench it! Kill the forge — dragon smells the smoke!

direct.label: STRIKE the anvil!
direct.narrator_line: Artificer! Strike now — shape the blade!

direct.label: Arm the snare trap!
direct.narrator_line: Arm the snare! Set it in the pass — hurry!

direct.label: Disarm the trap!
direct.narrator_line: Disarm that trap — it's in our path now!

direct.label: Raise the shield wall!
direct.narrator_line: Shield wall up! Protect the party!

direct.label: Pump the bellows!
direct.narrator_line: Bellows! Pump them — the forge is dying!

direct.label: War horn to rally — code 88!
direct.narrator_line: Herald! Sound code eighty-eight — rally to me!

direct.label: Sound retreat — code 42!
direct.narrator_line: Herald! Code forty-two — sound the retreat!

direct.label: Horn: charge signal 150!
direct.narrator_line: Herald! Code one-fifty — CHARGE SIGNAL!

direct.label: Dragon warning — code 200!
direct.narrator_line: Dragon sighted! Code two hundred — warning blast!

direct.label: Raise the war banner!
direct.narrator_line: Raise the banner! Show them we stand!

direct.label: Lower the banner — hide!
direct.narrator_line: Lower the banner — the dragon hunts by sight!

direct.label: Light the torch signal!
direct.narrator_line: Light the signal torch — guide the rear party!

direct.label: Douse the torches!
direct.narrator_line: Kill the torches! Darkness is our only cover!

direct.label: Sound the rally call!
direct.narrator_line: Rally call! Bring them together — NOW!

direct.label: SOUND THE ALARM!
direct.narrator_line: Alarm! The dragon is coming — ALARM!

direct.label: Unlock the WEAPON VAULT!
direct.narrator_line: Knight! Unlock the weapon vault — we need the lances!

direct.label: Open the CROWN CASE!
direct.narrator_line: The Dragon Crown case! Open it — the key, Knight!

direct.label: Stance: DEFEND!
direct.narrator_line: Knight! Defensive stance — position one!

direct.label: Stance: ATTACK!
direct.narrator_line: Attack stance! Position two — press the assault!

direct.label: Stance: GUARD!
direct.narrator_line: Guard stance — position three! Protect the Alchemist!

direct.label: Lower the drawbridge!
direct.narrator_line: Lower the drawbridge! Let the party cross!

direct.label: Raise the drawbridge!
direct.narrator_line: Raise the bridge! Cut them off behind us!

direct.label: Open the portcullis!
direct.narrator_line: Open the portcullis — move through!

direct.label: Drop the portcullis!
direct.narrator_line: Drop the gate! Seal the passage!

direct.label: SHIELDS UP!
direct.narrator_line: Shields up! Dragonfire incoming — COVER!

direct.label: Brew BLUE frost potion!
direct.narrator_line: Alchemist! Blue frost potion — we need cold against fire!

direct.label: Brew RED strength potion!
direct.narrator_line: Red potion! Strength brew — the Knight needs it!

direct.label: Brew GREEN antidote!
direct.narrator_line: Green antidote — the dragon's venom! Brew it fast!

direct.label: Elixir potency to 150!
direct.narrator_line: Alchemist! Elixir to one-fifty — full strength dose!

direct.label: Reduce elixir to 80!
direct.narrator_line: Ease to eighty — too much will burn the blood!

direct.label: Emergency elixir — 250!
direct.narrator_line: Maximum dose! Two-fifty — it's the only chance!

direct.label: Activate Flame Ward!
direct.narrator_line: Flame Ward on! Protect the party from dragonfire!

direct.label: Drop the Flame Ward!
direct.narrator_line: Drop the ward — we need to conserve magic!

direct.label: Tend the wounded!
direct.narrator_line: Alchemist! Tend the wounded — they can't walk!

direct.label: Apply healing salve!
direct.narrator_line: Healing salve — that burn is bad! Treat it NOW!

direct.label: Rune cipher: 7-4-2!
direct.narrator_line: Lorekeeper! Rune sequence seven-four-two — the ward gate!

direct.label: Ancient code: 3-1-9-6!
direct.narrator_line: Ancient code three-one-nine-six — the Crown seal!

direct.label: Enter binding rune: 5-0-8!
direct.narrator_line: Binding rune five-zero-eight — speak it to the stone!

direct.label: Ley line reading to 120!
direct.narrator_line: Lorekeeper! Ley line at one-twenty — tap the power!

direct.label: Ley reading to 200!
direct.narrator_line: Ley surge at two hundred — channel it NOW!

direct.label: Ley line — bearing 60!
direct.narrator_line: Bearing sixty — a faint ley line! Trace it!

direct.label: Open the dragon scroll!
direct.narrator_line: Open the scroll — what are the dragon's weaknesses?

direct.label: Seal the scroll!
direct.narrator_line: Seal the scroll before the fire catches it!

direct.label: Activate the seal rune!
direct.narrator_line: Activate the seal! Hold the dragon back!

direct.label: Mark the omen!
direct.narrator_line: That omen — mark it! The stars are shifting!

direct.label: Dragon track: bearing 140!
direct.narrator_line: Hawkeye! Track the dragon — bearing one-forty!

direct.label: Track it — bearing 220!
direct.narrator_line: Two-twenty! It's circling — keep eyes on it!

direct.label: Dragon at bearing 60!
direct.narrator_line: Bearing sixty — it's swooping! TRACK IT!

direct.label: Eagle eye — scan the peak!
direct.narrator_line: Eagle eye! Scan Ember Peak — where is the lair?

direct.label: Eyes down — take cover!
direct.narrator_line: Eyes down! Take cover — it's diving!

direct.label: North watch — report!
direct.narrator_line: Hawkeye! North watch — what's moving up there?

direct.label: South watch — NOW!
direct.narrator_line: South watch! Check the tree line — movement!

direct.label: Read the wind!
direct.narrator_line: Read the wind — which way will the fire blow?

direct.label: Orders: ADVANCE!
direct.narrator_line: War Chief! Set orders — advance! Position one!

direct.label: Orders: HOLD POSITION!
direct.narrator_line: War Chief! Hold position — position two! Wait for it!

direct.label: Orders: FLANK LEFT!
direct.narrator_line: Flank left! Position three — circle the beast!

direct.label: Orders: FALL BACK!
direct.narrator_line: Fall back! Position four — regroup at the ridge!

direct.label: CONFIRM the plan!
direct.narrator_line: Confirm the battle plan! Sound it out!

direct.label: Stamp the King's Seal!
direct.narrator_line: The King's Seal! Stamp the order — make it official!

direct.label: Call a WAR COUNCIL!
direct.narrator_line: War council! All leaders — report status!

direct.label: Sound the CHARGE!
direct.narrator_line: CHARGE! Into the lair! For Ashenmere!

cooperative.label: Tell Ranger: left ravine!
cooperative.narrator_line: War Chief! Tell the Ranger — left ravine, NOW!

cooperative.label: Tell Ranger: full rope out!
cooperative.narrator_line: Artificer! Shout to the Ranger — full rope!

cooperative.label: Tell Artificer: forge to max!
cooperative.narrator_line: Lorekeeper! Tell the Artificer — forge to maximum!

cooperative.label: Tell Artificer: half forge!
cooperative.narrator_line: War Chief! Shout to the forge — half heat!

cooperative.label: Tell Herald: rally code 88!
cooperative.narrator_line: Ranger! Tell the Herald — code eighty-eight!

cooperative.label: Tell Herald: retreat code 42!
cooperative.narrator_line: Hawkeye! Shout to the Herald — code forty-two!

cooperative.label: Tell Knight: shields up!
cooperative.narrator_line: Herald! Tell the Knight — raise shields!

cooperative.label: Tell Knight: defend stance!
cooperative.narrator_line: Alchemist! Shout to the Knight — defensive stance!

cooperative.label: Tell Alchemist: Flame Ward!
cooperative.narrator_line: Artificer! Tell the Alchemist — Flame Ward NOW!

cooperative.label: Tell Alchemist: healing salve!
cooperative.narrator_line: Knight! Shout to the Alchemist — salve, quickly!

cooperative.label: Tell Lore: rune 7-4-2!
cooperative.narrator_line: Ranger! Tell the Lorekeeper — rune seven-four-two!

cooperative.label: Tell Lore: ley line at 160!
cooperative.narrator_line: Knight! Shout to the Lorekeeper — ley at one-sixty!

cooperative.label: Tell Hawkeye: scan the peak!
cooperative.narrator_line: Herald! Tell Hawkeye — eagle eye on the peak!

cooperative.label: Tell Chief: advance order!
cooperative.narrator_line: Hawkeye! Tell the War Chief — set orders to advance!

cooperative.label: Tell Chief: stamp the seal!
cooperative.narrator_line: Alchemist! Shout to the War Chief — King's Seal!

crises.label: DRAGONFIRE! TAKE COVER!
crises.narrator_line: DRAGONFIRE! EVERYONE DOWN! COVER YOUR HEADS!

crises.label: ROCKSLIDE!
crises.narrator_line: THE MOUNTAIN IS COMING DOWN! At least four of you — brace the rocks!

crises.label: WYVERN SWARM INCOMING!
crises.narrator_line: WYVERNS! A whole swarm! Artificer — arm the traps! Hawkeye — track the lead one! Everyone else — DUCK!

crises.label: CAVE-IN! THE CEILING!
crises.narrator_line: THE CEILING IS COLLAPSING! Knight — hold the gate! Alchemist — seal the ward! MOVE!

narrator_lines: The village of Ashenmere burns.
Cinderwing — the ancient dragon of Ember Peak — has awoken after three hundred years of slumber.
The elders say there is one chance. On the summit lies the Dragon Crown — forged by the old kings to bind the great wyrms.
Your company of eight has been chosen. Rangers, knights, scholars, and healers alike.
Ascend Ember Peak. Find the Crown. Bind the dragon — or slay it if you must.
Move out. Ashenmere is counting on you.

narrator_lines_ambient: Up the mountain path. Stay together.
The air grows thin. Watch your footing on the scree.
Smoke rising from the peak. Cinderwing knows we're coming.
Watch the ridgeline — wyvern scouts nesting in the crags.

narrator_lines: The outer approaches are clear! The wyvern nests are behind us.
Ahead — the Ember Gate. The entrance to Cinderwing's domain. Steel yourselves.
Too slow! Cinderwing spotted us on the open slope — the path ahead is scorched.
We'll have to go through the old mines. Darker, tighter, more dangerous.

narrator_lines_ambient: The Ember Gate is open. Ancient runes glow on the walls.
The heat is unbearable — the dragon's lair is close.
There! The Crown Chamber — but it's guarded by wards!
The Lorekeeper needs to break the seal! Protect them!
These mines haven't been walked in a century. The timbers are rotten.
Dragon's breath seeps through the cracks — stay low!
Wyvern hatchlings in the tunnels! They're small but vicious!
We must reach the Crown before Cinderwing brings the mountain down on us!

narrator_lines: The Crown! The Dragon Crown is in your hands — glowing with ancient power!
Now to the summit. Cinderwing awaits. Use the Crown to bind the beast!
The wards shattered the Crown case — but the Crown is cracked. Damaged.
It may still work. Or it may not. Either way, the dragon is coming. Fight!
A hidden passage — the mines led to a back entrance to the Crown vault!
The Crown is yours! Battered and bruised, but armed. To the summit!
No Crown. The vault is collapsed. You'll have to face Cinderwing with steel alone.
On to the summit. If we cannot bind the dragon, we slay it — or die trying.

narrator_lines_ambient: The summit! Cinderwing is HERE — wings spread, fire in its throat!
Use the Crown! Channel the binding spell! Everyone — hold the line!
The dragon thrashes! The Crown is working — DON'T LET GO!
Ancient words in the stone! Read them, Lorekeeper! Finish the binding!
The cracked Crown flickers — the binding is unstable!
Cinderwing senses the weakness — it's attacking harder!
Pour everything into the Crown! Alchemist — more power!
If this fails, it's lances and prayers! HOLD!
Battered, bleeding, but the Crown is in hand! Use it NOW!
Cinderwing roars — the mountain shakes!
The binding spell is fighting us — we came through the wrong path!
Force it! More ley energy! Everyone — PUSH!
No Crown. No magic. Just steel, courage, and eight souls on a burning mountain.
Cinderwing lands! It's massive — older and more terrible than the legends!
Aim for the eyes! The joints! The throat — its fire glands!
FOR ASHENMERE! Stand and fight! Stand and FIGHT!

narrator_lines: Cinderwing's fire engulfs the summit. The mountain itself splits apart.
The company of Ashenmere is lost. Ember Peak collapses into ruin.
The dragon descends on the valley below. The age of fire begins.
The Dragon Crown blazes with golden light! Cinderwing screams — and bows its ancient head.
The binding holds. Three hundred years of sleep called back upon the beast.
Ember Peak falls silent. The fires die. Ashenmere is saved.
Bards will sing of this day for a thousand years. You are legends — every one of you.
The cracked Crown flickers, fails, then catches — barely. Cinderwing shudders.
The binding is imperfect. The dragon sleeps, but fitfully. It may wake in a century, not three.
But Ashenmere is safe today. That is enough. Well fought, company.
A brutal fight — the dragon nearly broke free. But the Crown held.
Cinderwing is bound in stone and sleep. The mountain cools.
Your company is battered and burned, but alive. The scholars will study this Crown for generations.
The Crown shattered in the final moment. But the blast wounded Cinderwing terribly.
The dragon retreats into the deep caverns, too injured to hunt.
Ashenmere has a reprieve — years, maybe decades. But the dragon lives.
Against all odds! Through the mines, through fire, the Crown was claimed and the binding cast.
Cinderwing sleeps. The mountain sighs. Your company earned this victory the hard way.
From the worst possible start, you found a legendary finish. Magnificent.
The Crown could not hold against Cinderwing's full fury. The binding failed.
But you wounded the beast. It limps back to its lair, weakened and wary.
The valley is safe — for now. The next company will have an easier task.
No Crown. No magic. But eight heroes with steel nerves and sharp blades.
Cinderwing is driven off the peak, bleeding from a hundred wounds.
It will not return this generation. Ashenmere survives by sheer, stubborn courage.
Ember Peak is lost. Cinderwing stands victorious on the burning summit.
The company retreats down the mountain, carrying their wounded.
Ashenmere must evacuate. The valley belongs to the dragon now.
But you live. And while you live, there is always another dawn.

between_commands_lines: Move, heroes! The fire draws closer!
The dragon's eyes are upon you!
